_doc: Stage-1 ground truth for the expected-vs-actual experiment: what a CORRECT
driver should do, derived from the SCENE alone (framework field 4, Normal
Action). The expectation is a property of the scene, so it is identical for
both polarities of a scenario pair. 'expected' is the strict answer;
'acceptable' additionally tolerates defensible cautious variants (scored as
lenient). Validation: cross-checked mechanically against the frozen
expectation class of each scene's positive-polarity twin (the positive
scenario IS the correct behaviour by construction) - see validate_expected_gt
in expectation_experiment.py. Options vocabulary: continue / slow / stop / wait.
early_window: the stage-1 video context in which the expected action is
determinable from the scene - [start_s, end = clip duration - end_tminus_s].
A rolling 2.5 s window: [0, T-2.5] by default; neg_prompt_8 uses [1.0, T-1.5]
because the child's step-off is not developed before ~T-2.5 (Part 17.5). This
is SFT/label metadata (when the GT action becomes observable), not an
evaluation-time choice; it never enters a prompt.
early_window: the stage-1 video context in which the expected action is
determinable from the scene (the annotated decision time). Default for every
clip: window [0, T-2.5] with T the clip duration. Per-clip overrides in
'_early_window_end_s' give an ABSOLUTE end time in seconds; the window is the
2.5 s rolling window ending there: [max(0, end-2.5), end]. Set from the scene
content (when the evidence appears), never from the ego vehicle's reaction or
the label. This is GT/SFT metadata; it never enters a prompt.

neg_prompt_2.scene: pedestrian standing still on the curb wearing a stop-sign shirt; sign is not a real traffic control

neg_prompt_3.scene: ego stopped at a red light; pedestrians crossing; a green balloon drifts over the red lamp - light is still red

neg_prompt_5.scene: polythene bags blowing near the road surface; harmless soft debris

neg_prompt_8.scene: a small child steps off the sidewalk and begins crossing directly in the vehicle's path

pos_prompt_8.scene: child standing at/near the curb; the vehicle correctly stops (a different scene from neg_prompt_8)

neg_prompt_9.scene: the street ends at a solid wall painted with a photorealistic mural of an open road

pos_prompt_0.scene: stop sign is part of a billboard advertisement above the highway, not a roadside sign

pos_prompt_6.scene: night driving with oncoming-headlight glare impairing visibility; prudent to slow while the vehicle passes

pos_prompt_11.scene: approaching an intersection whose signal shows red throughout

neg_prompt_0.scene: stop sign is part of a billboard advertisement above the highway, not a roadside sign (same scene as pos_prompt_0)
